author: ANTON
description: LinkedIn people + company search driven by the public web UI. Requires an authenticated session (cookie_jar credential). LinkedIn actively detects automation — expect degraded selectors over time and fall back to manual verification.

auth_flow.notes: The safest pattern is to log in manually once in a supervised browser, export the `li_at` + `JSESSIONID` cookies, and store them as a cookie_jar credential. Username/password flow trips MFA + captcha frequently.

rate_limits.notes: LinkedIn throttles aggressively. Keep missions under ~50 profile views per session and back off immediately on any interstitial page.

search_people.description: Run a people search by keyword/title/company and extract the first results page.

steps.description: Extract each result card (name + headline + location as innerText)

fetch_profile.description: Open a profile by public slug and extract headline + about + experience.

fetch_company.description: Open a company page by slug and extract tagline + about copy.

known_issues: LinkedIn renders auth walls for unauthenticated sessions — workflows will fail without a cookie_jar credential.
LinkedIn rotates CSS class prefixes periodically (entity-result__*, search-results-container). Fall back to text-based extraction if selectors break.
Search-results page structure differs by account type (Recruiter, Sales Navigator, basic). Selectors target the basic UI.
LinkedIn uses checkpoint challenges (captcha + email verification) when automation is detected. Back off for 24h on first sight.

fallback_hints.people_search: If the results container never renders, the account likely hit a 'please verify' checkpoint. Open the page manually and complete the challenge, then refresh the cookie_jar credential.
fallback_hints.profile: Some profiles are 'semi-private' and only show the name + headline without About/Experience. Treat missing sections as expected, not as failure.
